non_idle_rule: After every result or interruption, immediately analyze, log, and launch the next experiment. The watchdog recovers only declared queued workers. When the queue is empty, the primary Codex process must plan and enqueue the next experiments. Wait only for an active process, active Codex planning, or required external operation. Stop only on exact top-level STOP.
current_hypothesis: A matched full-train_pref-only Qwen SFT control, using the same initialization seed, preference split, and optimizer settings as the 250-example Glaive candidate, will isolate whether a Glaive contribution improves source-specific clean validation. Candidate selection will use clean validation only. The frozen aggregate-only official test measurement will follow training and validation.
